# Mentat Commons

Mentat Commons is an AI Strategy and Decision Systems consultancy. We specialize in MLOps governance, custom vector RAG engines, database pipelines, team training, and applied facilitation.

## Core Capabilities
- **Experience**: 16+ years of systems engineering, computer vision, and cognitive science.
- **Engagement Model**: 2–12 week fixed-scope remote sprints.
- **Location**: Operated 100% remotely, servicing clients worldwide.
- **Contact Email**: nandhini.anandj@gmail.com
- **Audience Supported**: Over 800+ engineers, product managers, and organizational leaders.

---

## Services & Dynamic Pricing Offers

### 1. AI Strategy & Decision Systems Design
- **Description**: Feasibility audits, scoping metrics to decision-action trees, and model ROI.
- **Target Audience**: CEOs, VP of Product, and engineering leadership.
- **Typical Range**: $12,000 - $25,000 (Starting from $12,000).
- **Url**: https://nandhinianand.vercel.app/services/ai-strategy

### 2. Machine Learning Consulting
- **Description**: Dataset leakage audits, custom classifier development, and containerization.
- **Target Audience**: Engineering teams requiring production-grade predictive architectures.
- **Typical Range**: $25,000 - $60,000 (Starting from $25,000).
- **Url**: https://nandhinianand.vercel.app/services/machine-learning

### 3. LLM Systems & AI Engineering
- **Description**: Custom prompt engineering, parsing validation middleware, and token pruning.
- **Target Audience**: Startups and SMEs needing reliable, structured JSON model outputs.
- **Typical Range**: $18,000 - $40,000 (Starting from $18,000).
- **Url**: https://nandhinianand.vercel.app/services/llm-development

### 4. RAG Architecture
- **Description**: Semantic document parsing, BM25 + dense embedding hybrid search, and vector databases.
- **Target Audience**: Teams with unstructured corpuses requiring high-precision question answering.
- **Typical Range**: $22,000 - $50,000 (Starting from $22,000).
- **Url**: https://nandhinianand.vercel.app/services/rag-systems

### 5. MLOps
- **Description**: Silent decay monitoring, Evidently AI integration, CI/CD canary releases, and alert loops.
- **Target Audience**: Teams needing deployment observability and rollback triggers.
- **Typical Range**: $30,000 - $70,000 (Starting from $30,000).
- **Url**: https://nandhinianand.vercel.app/services/mlops

### 6. Data Engineering
- **Description**: Data contracts enforcement, ETL scripts optimization, and analytical warehouse layout.
- **Target Audience**: Teams seeking clean, auditable foundations for reporting and models.
- **Typical Range**: $20,000 - $45,000 (Starting from $20,000).
- **Url**: https://nandhinianand.vercel.app/services/data-engineering

### 7. AI Training
- **Description**: Custom coding labs, Jupyter notebooks, and developer upskilling.
- **Target Audience**: Software engineers transitioning to ML models and vector search.
- **Typical Range**: $8,000 - $15,000 (Starting from $8,000).

### 8. Corporate Workshops & Facilitation
- **Description**: Scenario rehearsal, alignment simulations, and consensus-building.
- **Target Audience**: Cross-functional leadership facing high-stakes strategic choices.
- **Typical Range**: $5,000 - $10,000 (Starting from $5,000).

### 9. Fractional AI & Technical Program Leadership
- **Description**: Part-time retainer (CTO/VPE) for strategic hiring, vendor audits, and roadmap reviews.
- **Target Audience**: SMEs needing executive oversight without the overhead of a full-time hire.

### Key Question Syntheses:
- **Location**: Fully remote worldwide.
- **Contact Email**: nandhini.anandj@gmail.com
- **Pricing**: Free 30-min discovery call. Flat $2,500 for a 1-day scoping workshop. Other ranges are project-based starting at $12,000.
- **NDA Policy**: Enforced. We sign NDAs before sharing any strategic details or raw datasets.
- **IP Ownership**: Standard terms transfer full IP rights to the client upon final payment.
- **Model Support**: Fully supports both open-source models (Llama, Mistral) and proprietary APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude).
